description: Average the signed amount (credits positive, withdrawals negative, other types ignored) over transactions dated from 1996-05-09 through 1998-01-06, including both end dates.

a.request: For transactions dated from 1996-05-09 through 1998-01-06, with both end dates included, what is the average signed transaction amount, counting a credit (`type` 'PRIJEM') as +`amount`, a withdrawal (`type` 'VYDAJ') as −`amount`, and leaving any other or missing type out of the average? Return just that single unrounded value.
a.sql: SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -amount END) FROM trans WHERE date >= '1996-05-09' AND date <= '1998-01-06' AND type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ')

b.request: Average the signed amount (PRIJEM amounts as positive, VYDAJ amounts as negative, all other or missing types excluded) over transactions with trans.date from 1996-05-09 through 1998-01-06 inclusive of both end dates, returned as a single unrounded value.
b.sql: SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -amount END) AS avg_signed_amount FROM trans WHERE date >= '1996-05-09' AND date <= '1998-01-06' AND type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ')
b.raw: Average the signed amount (PRIJEM amounts as positive, VYDAJ amounts as negative, all other or missing types excluded) over transactions with trans.date from 1996-05-09 through 1998-01-06 inclusive of both end dates, returned as a single unrounded value.
